gotchas: NO REGISTER MAP EXISTS FROM ROLLS. This is the single most important fact about the line. Every Rolls document states the transport and then names a third-party protocol by title and version; not one CAN ID, Modbus address, scale factor or bit meaning appears in any Rolls publication. The pack impersonates a protocol chosen in Rolls LFP Desktop V2 software over the RS-485 port. Appendix A of the operating manual lists, verbatim: Deye 'ENQ CAN protocol V1.0' CAN 500K · Goodwe 'Goodwe Communication Protocol' CAN 500K V1.5 · Growatt-SPF 'Growatt BMS CAN-Busprotocol-low-voltage' CAN 500K V1.05 and 'SPF

Two of those entries are the practical route for Cabin Hub and both are widely implemented outside Rolls: Pylontech RS-485 low-voltage V3.5 at 9600, and Pylontech CAN V1.3 at 500K. Neither is a Rolls document and neither is verified against a Rolls pack here.

The manual's Solis row says 'CAN, 9600'. 9600 is not a CAN bit rate. Recorded as printed rather than corrected — it is either a typo for 500K or a genuine oddity, and guessing would be exactly the fabrication this catalogue forbids.

The SRNE row names 'PACE BMS Modbus Protocol' as a selectable output. That hints the BMS is PACE-derived, which would matter because PACE has multiple community implementations. It is a hint, not evidence — the manual lists it as an inverter-side option, not as a statement about internal architecture. Tagged unverified
unmappedReports: charge-voltage-limit (CVL) — the BMS publishes it and Victron DVCC consumes it; no MetricKind exists to read a limit back, only the CommandKind set-charge-current-limit to write one, charge-current-limit (CCL) — same gap, discharge-current-limit (DCL) — same gap, BMS alarm / protection flags (over-voltage, under-voltage, over-temperature, under-temperature, over-current). ChargeStage::Fault is the charger's fault, not a battery protection state. Appendix B error codes ER0-ER4 have nowhere to land., per-cell voltages and cell delta — battery-voltage is pack terminal voltage only, remaining capacity in Ah and full-charge capacity in Ah — consumed-amp-hours is the inverse and is not the same number, internal heater state (S-Series packs have self-heating; the display shows a Heating indicator), BMS switch / breaker position — switch-state could carry it but nothing currently maps it, pack address / number of packs in a parallel string
